newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up slightly at noon, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up slightly at noon, trade slow.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were up marginally at midday on Wednesday with most investors sidelined due to the approach of the four-day Labour Day holiday, brokers said.
The B share index edged up 0.415 points or 0.46 percent to 89.771 points on volume of 15.131 million shares worth $8.625 million, compared with $8.63 million on Tuesday.
Position-adjusting trading dominated today's market, brokers said, adding that some overseas investors were seen reducing their positions to put capital to better use during the holiday.
The strong overnight strong performance by stocks in New York had no impact on the Shanghai B share market, brokers said.
"With firms' results becoming clear, position-adjusting trading dominated the market," one broker said. "Market sentiment is cautious ahead of the holiday."

"The direction of the index after the holiday will mainly depend on whether there is market-moving news issued during the holiday and the performance of the last annual report of market giant Shanghai Chlor Alkai," another broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 38 traded, with 15 up, eight flat and 15 down.
Shanghai Kaikai Industrial was the star and the most actively traded share on institutional window-dressing buying, jumping $0.028 or 6.08 percent to $0.448 on volume of 2.2 million shares.
Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development followed on domestic investors' buying, up $0.038 or 4.97 percent to 0.802 on volume of 990,400 shares.
Shanghai's A share index inched up, but the market direction was unclear ahead of the holiday, brokers said.
The index put on 1.910 points or 0.13 percent to 1,440.996 points on volume of 319.3 million shares worth 4.3 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index rose 6.412 points or 0.16 percent to 3,950.387 points.
Hebei Weiyuan Industry was the star on institutional support, jumping 1.12 yuan or 7.84 percent to 15.40 yuan on volume of 1.9 million shares.
